name: ossify
description: Skeleton-first lifecycle from Release 0 through MVP and v1. An alternate replacement for scaffold-onboard + scaffold-dev, not a stage alongside them.

interface.shortDescription: Drive a project from Release 0 through MVP and v1, skeleton first.
interface.longDescription: Ossify plans a release as a skeleton, drives its spine round by round, and closes it with a ceremony that harvests what the round learned. It replaces the scaffold-onboard + scaffold-dev pair rather than composing with them — install one lifecycle or the other, not both. In Codex the six entry skills load natively; the Claude Code surface additionally exposes the slash commands and the implementer subagent.
defaultPrompt: Open a new release with ossify.
Plan the spine for this release.
Run the next round of the spine.
